scope: Read-only host and runtime provenance, correlated with separately recorded live service reports. This is not a full acceptance or production certification.

collection.package_probe: importlib.metadata.version in each installed Python environment
collection.metal_probe: Import mlx.core; read mlx.core.metal.is_available() and mlx.core.default_device() in each environment. No tensor computation or model load.
collection.sandbox_note: Sandboxed Metal imports could not access the device. The read-only probe outside the sandbox succeeded for both environments.
collection.path_redactions: Startup excerpts replace the project and home directories with <project> and <home>. Machine identifiers are omitted.

model.bundle_reference_source: Local runtime launchers and startup logs identify this content-addressed bundle; model weight files were not rehashed during this collection.
model.hash_verification: The installed tokenizer_config.json, its original chat_template string, and the selected project template were rehashed and matched config/qwen3-template-provenance.json.
model.template_change: Render developer messages with their own role header instead of dropping them. No weights or upstream tokenizer files are modified.

evidence_limits: Linked live reports carry their own run times, assertions and outcomes. Their check counts are intentionally not copied here; consult the current report files.
GPU availability alone does not certify execution. The hardware conclusion combines native startup evidence, selected launch configuration and the separately recorded actual inference reports.
No external GPU profiler trace, energy measurement or exhaustive CPU/remote-fallback detection was collected.
Native log paths are local ignored runtime artifacts; the selected timestamped excerpts are embedded here for a portable record.
Historical native-runtime.json and sglang-runtime.json describe earlier launcher snapshots, including legacy native response modes. They do not override the current service-owned Core contract.
Python SDK tests use the pinned native environment client; the SGLang server environment independently installs openai 2.6.1.
